author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The AI labs rely on the users of the $200 plan to provide them training data for the next gen model.

Here is a structural dilemma.

1. You know the AI lab uses your code or work to train the next gen model.
2. You only use it to work on open source or fun stuff, so the next gen model can't go after your real job

As a result, the next gen model keep learning cool new things that can't make any money.
